summary: Read your Web Clipper saves, mark them read, and tag them.
page_description: A reader for Obsidian Web Clipper articles, with sync back to your vault.

steps.text: Clip articles into your vault with Obsidian Web Clipper.
Install the Cobalt Clippings Sync Obsidian plugin, which pushes clippings to this app and merges read/tag changes back into your notes.
Set your reader's address in that plugin's settings, then push from Obsidian or open Clippings on the reader.
